findings.title: The 16-test source-path reader class is incomplete: 6 more tests (7 IDs) read worktree source files by path at runtime and stay in the paired baseline/candidate comparison

read_paths.test_compiled_d96_flag_device_and_scalar: tensor_cuda/src/kernels.cu, tensor_cuda/src/paint_bake.cu via common.load_runtime() -> verify_sources() (scripts/apa_sp3_common.py:181-182); refuses 'pre-existing source changed: tensor_cuda/src/kernels.cu' on both arms -- the same mechanism as the listed test_every_preexisting_source_and_kernel_body_pinned
read_paths.test_a4_calibration_uses_actual_ppl_frac: 14 scripts/apa_sp4g*.py/.sh files read by scripts/apa_sp4g_common.py (same kind as the listed .sh/.py readers)

findings.reproduction: python3 -B artifacts/eng1/rev2/run.py q2_readers_{A,B,C} python3 -B artifacts/eng1/rev2/q2_source_readers.py TAG <files>: all 49 regression files (2133 IDs) run on CPU, CUDA hidden, candidate arm preloaded and PYTHONPATH-bound, under a PEP 578 audit hook that attributes every worktree file read to the running test ID and fences every write outside /tmp/eng1_rev2_work and every subprocess. q2_classify_reads.py -> q2_classify_reads.json: 19 tests observed reading non-receipt, non-order worktree files by path (excluding imports, traceback rendering, temp-tree walks); 13 are in A1's 16; these 6 are not. Of the 16 listed, 3 were not observed: two fail on CPU before reaching their reads (test_registration_and_every_existing_kernel_body_pinned, test_a6_bridge_all_old_kinds_future_edits_and_receipt_bytes) and one reads a file outside this worktree (test_a2_source_pins_pre_branch_norm_rope_v_and_scale); their inclusion is not disputed. q2_probe_sources (probe_test_sources.py): verify_sources/load_runtime refuse with 'Red: pre-existing source changed: tensor_cuda/src/kernels.cu'. The 7 IDs are all in tool/ids_a1_regression.txt (the 2117-ID comparison set).
findings.argument: A1's binding fix 2 requires that 'tests that read candidate source files by path are listed in their own class ... and are excluded from the baseline/candidate regression comparison'; A1's report and G3 state the 16 form that class. Both arms read the same worktree files, so these tests' source-dependent outcomes are arm-independent and cannot measure the arm; a source pin broken by the candidate fails in both arms and passes the no-new-regression rule. Observed impact on G5 is nil for these 7 IDs: test_compiled_d96 already fails before ENG1 (SP3 registration kernels.cu sha256 6c416ece... differs from the pre-ENG1 1680764d file d90124e0... and the candidate 7d52c1a5...), and the a5/a4 readers record or check unchanged files. Not observed: reads after a first CUDA call in GPU-only paths (CPU run).
findings.suggested_fix: Add the 6 test selectors to source_reading_tests.json and SOURCE_READING_TESTS.md with their paths; rerun stage.py's census (ids_a1_regression.txt becomes 2110 IDs) and reseal (new seal file). Prefer deriving the class from a runtime read attribution like q2_source_readers.py rather than a hand list.

findings.title: engine_distance_from_emulation is null in exactly the four rows where honest arithmetic is nonfinite, so the census cannot say whether the engine's nonfinite pattern matches it
findings.reproduction: a1/e3_emulation.json: LayerNorm/RMSNorm/BatchNorm1D float16 near_eps backward have 64/64 nonfinite emulation values, InstanceNorm2D 96/96; e3_distance returns None if either vector has any nonfinite element. My own LayerNorm emulation (q1_emulation_check.json) reproduces the 64/64. Equal nonfinite counts do not show equal positions, signs, or inf versus NaN.
findings.argument: Measurement only, no gate, and A1 disclosed it (report line 26). It loses the one comparison these rows exist for.
findings.suggested_fix: Also record nonfinite_pattern_equal = np.array_equal(np.where(np.isfinite(got), 0, got), np.where(np.isfinite(emu), 0, emu), equal_nan=True) and the max distance over jointly finite elements. Fix once and close (11-03 rule).

questions.Q1_R1-F01: SOUND. The tape in test_eng1.py matches nn.py and ops.cpp/autograd.cpp/kernels.cu op for op (reductions, scalar float casts, pow VJP, cast VJP, accumulation order from the post-order DFS). My own straight-line emulation (PyTorch rounding, hand-written lane reduction, hand-ordered reverse pass), not a tape, is bit-equal to it on all 16 LayerNorm and GroupNorm rows (both dtypes, both cases, both directions). My float64 reference agrees with e3_reference within 5.7e-14. The errors match a1/e3_emulation.json within 1e-12. The review's two numbers reproduce within 2.8e-17. e3_round equals PyTorch's float16/bfloat16 conversion on 1,048,576 random float32 patterns plus ties, subnormals, overflow edges and NaN. The tolerances are labelled 'accuracy targets (not error bounds)' at test_eng1.py:14, 285, 307 and 581. No E3 ID is a gate: test_e3_census asserts only shape, dtype and reference validity, no E3 ID is among the 59 baseline expected failures, and score_gpu.py only reports the census. NIT R2-F02.
questions.Q2_R1-F02: Binding: SOUND. All 24 staged lines run run_gpu_tests.py, which puts arms/<arm>/tensor_cuda first on PYTHONPATH (os.environ.update(bound_environment(package))) before any test import. The origin preflight runs before 'import pytest' (run_gpu_tests.py:84-85 bind and preflight, :91 import pytest; uncaught refusal -> exit 2 at :139) and exits 2, which is not the mutants' expected 1. evidence.evaluate re-validates it. REV1's probe scenario, rerun per arm: unbound gives exit 1 and ModuleNotFoundError (control reproduced); bound gives preflight exit 0 and the scenario exits 0 importing the arm's own pin (baseline 73ededa0, candidate 3e6d5805). The wrong-pin preflight refuses with 'subprocess pin mismatch' before pytest is imported. A decoy tensor_cuda package in the cwd is refused ('subprocess origin check failed'). The 16-test list is NOT complete: R2-F01.
questions.Q3_R1-F03: SOUND. In exact rational arithmetic with my own IEEE round-to-nearest-even, for the bfloat16 witness x = 0.0002994537353515625, g = 0.30078125, p = 3: the reference is 5693919*2^-46; late cast 174*2^-31, error 1.0961e-10 (0.347 of the tolerance); M15 early cast 173*2^-31, error 3.5605e-10 (1.126 of the tolerance 3.1615e-10). The tolerance has the registered form (2^-8 + 2^-20)*|ref| + 2^-134. The result holds for powf errors from -4 to +4 ulp, so M15 is killed. Call path: x.pow(3.0) -> ops.cpp pow_scalar grad_fn, dt == BFloat16 -> the line M15 edits, with upstream g exact. The float16 witness separates too (1.50 times the tolerance against 0.045). The baseline arm passes the bfloat16 witness and fails the float16 one at every powf error, matching baseline_expected_failures_a1.json.
questions.Q4_R1-F04: SOUND. make_dims (conv.cu:141-143) gives OH = floor((6-3)/1)+1 = 4 and OW = floor((2-3)/1)+1 = 0 for all four callers. The candidate's own exact refusal message, which the test checks, reports '(4, 0)'. M16 changes only 'ow <= 0' to 'ow < 0' (mutants/M16/mutation.diff). A1's receipt shows all 4 ow_zero IDs failing with 'DID NOT RAISE', child exit 1. My rerun of the CPU subset on the M16 arm (pin c597a30c): exactly those 4 IDs fail, 43 pass.
questions.Q5_R1-F05: SOUND. 10 entries checked against the source: __init__.py:553:35, functional.py:189:53, functional.py:190:12, nn.py:304:15, nn.py:498:12, nn.py:498:45, nn.py:576:12, quant.py:124:9, quant.py:186:11, quantization/affine.py:156:14. Each has the call text, the receiver type (NumPy or engine) and an element-count reason that match. Independent tokenize count: 46 '.reshape(' calls on 41 physical lines; the census has 46 rows, 37 engine and 9 NumPy, and the engine calls sit on 32 token lines.
questions.Q6_nothing_new_broken: SOUND. git diff 5031c765 7cf46bd5 -- . ':!artifacts/eng1' ':!orders' ':!logs' touches only tensor_cuda/tests/test_eng1.py (204+/7-), and it equals a1/test_eng1.diff byte for byte. The tool diff keeps parent-after-child: run_gpu_line.py changes only the seal name, the parent still waits on a foreground subprocess.run before evaluating and publishing, and the A1 audit receipts are ordered origin, junit, child_result, parent_result. The CPU subset on the candidate (pin 3e6d5805, CUDA hidden) gives 47 passed, 109 deselected, child exit 0, with an ID set identical to tool/ids_a1_audit.txt. Also run: C_COPY and C_UBSAN 47/47 passed; baseline 33 failed, all of them registered expected failures. All 20 arms' test_eng1.py copies equal the worktree file, and every module equals its seal pin.
